name: Breckerfeld (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, yellow and blue in the proportions 1:3:1, charged at the centre with the city arms of Breckerfeld (a white lily on blue above a chequy bar on yellow).
history: Arms, flag, banner and seal were granted to the city by deed of the Regierungspräsident in Arnsberg of 20 March 1979; the flag is blue-yellow-blue 1:3:1 striped with the shield at the centre.

features.role: Breckerfeld arms — lily and chequy bar
